title: Statements
intro: Upload your credit card statement as a PDF. I read the file on this computer; the card number, name and address are removed before anything is stored.
notPdf: You can only upload a PDF file.
slowHint: This can take more than a minute.
reconOkBody: The balance printed on the statement equals the sum of the lines I read: <m>{{amount}}</m>.
reconMismatchBody: The statement prints a balance of <m>{{expected}}</m>; the lines I read add up to <m>{{computed}}</m>. The difference is <c>{{difference}}</c>.
reconMismatchWhy: I may have missed a line, or the statement lists an item separately.
reconMismatchNext: I use the lines I read for every calculation. Compare them with your bank's transaction list before you pay.
reconNone: I could not compare the totals
reconNoneBody: This statement has no total I could check the lines against. Check the balance in your bank's app before you pay.
errTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errNetwork: I cannot reach the local server.
errParse: I got stuck somewhere while reading the statement. A diagnosis report can show where.
errInvalidPdf: This PDF does not open; the file may be damaged. Download it from your bank again and retry.
errNoProvider: Choose a tool in Settings first.
errProviderUnavailable: The tool you chose is not running on this computer right now.
errProviderFailed: The tool gave no usable answer. Try again in a moment.
errNoText: I read this statement with a bank template. Drafts are only made for statements the tool read.
gateLabel: Findings of the check before saving

gate.duplicate_statement: A statement for the same card and period is already stored.
gate.period_invalid: The period seems to start ({{start}}) after it ends ({{end}}).
gate.due_before_cut_off: The due date ({{due}}) seems to come before the cut-off date ({{end}}).
gate.no_transactions: I read no transaction lines, but the balance is not zero.
gate.amount_scale: A total and its lines differ by a factor of {{factor}}. I may have read the decimal separator wrong.
gate.period_unusual: The period lasts {{days}} days. Statements usually cover 20 to 45 days.
gate.not_reconciled: I could not compare the totals.
gate.reconciliation_mismatch: The lines add up to {{difference}} more or less than the printed total.
gate.no_printed_summary: I found no totals block on the statement, so I only checked the balance.
gate.rows_after_cut_off_one: One line is dated more than 3 days after the cut-off.
gate.rows_after_cut_off_other: {{count}} lines are dated more than 3 days after the cut-off.
gate.minimum_above_total: The minimum payment looks larger than the balance.
gate.installment_counter_one: In one line the installment number, the plan length and the count left disagree.
gate.installment_counter_other: In {{count}} lines the installment number, the plan length and the count left disagree.
gate.installment_sequence_one: One installment does not follow on from the previous statement.
gate.installment_sequence_other: {{count}} installments do not follow on from the previous statement.
gate.installment_missing_one: An installment that ran on the previous statement is missing here. It may have been paid off early, or I missed the line.
gate.installment_missing_other: {{count}} installments that ran on the previous statement are missing here. They may have been paid off early, or I missed the lines.

blockedTitle: I did not save the statement
blockedBody: I read the file, but the check before saving found a problem. I stopped so that a wrong amount does not end up in your figures.
blockedNext: If this is a reading error, a diagnosis report carries the layout needed to fix the bank's template.
passwordBody: Your bank protected the statement with a password. Type it and I will open and read the file; the password is used for this upload only.
passwordWrong: That password does not open the file. Try again.
passwordRememberHint: I keep the password in your computer's password store (keyring) and will not ask for the next statement. You can make me forget it in Settings.
passwordNoKeyring: I found no password store (keyring) on this computer, so I cannot keep the password. I will ask for it with every statement.
passwordHints: What banks say their statement password is
passwordRemembered: I keep the password for {{bank}} statements in the password store.
passwordNotRemembered: I could not keep the password. I will ask again with the next statement.
passwordNotRememberedAi: The tool read this statement. I only keep passwords for banks read by a template.
unknownTitle: I do not know this bank's layout
unknownTooLong: This PDF is too long for the tool as well. Send a diagnosis report and I will try to add the bank.
unknownNoProvider: This statement is from a bank I do not support yet. To have a tool read it, choose one in Settings. Otherwise, you can send a diagnosis report.
consentBody: This statement is from a bank I do not support yet. If you like, I can send the page text to {{name}} and have it read.
consentWhatValue: The statement's page text. Card number, name, address, IBAN, national ID, phone and long numbers are removed before sending.
consentAfterValue: The statement is saved as needing a check. Compare its lines with your bank's list.
aiFailedTitle: The tool could not read the statement
aiFailedBody: Its answer was unusable twice. You can try again or make a diagnosis report.
reviewBody: I saved the statement, but the check found a few inconsistencies. I use it in your figures; compare the points below with your bank's list.
reviewAi: The tool you chose read this statement. Compare its lines and totals with your bank's list once.
draftTitle: A template draft for this bank
draftIntro: The tool can write a template that describes this bank's layout from the text it read. If the draft passes the check, I can read the next statements without the tool.
draftReconOk: I tried it on the same text and the totals match.
draftReconOff: I tried it on the same text but could not compare the totals.
draftInvalid: The draft did not pass the check
draftNoDetect: The template did not recognise this statement.
draftShare: If you want others to use it, copy the draft and paste it into the last field of the form. Nothing is sent from this app on its own.
copyFailed: I could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
detailGone: This statement is no longer stored.
deleteBody: The statement, its lines and the installments that come from it are deleted. You cannot undo this, but you can upload the same PDF again.
filesIntro: Add a CSV, OFX or QIF file from your bank, or take what I store to a ledger program or a spreadsheet.
importHint: Do not also import a period you uploaded as a PDF; both would count.
importUnreadable: I could not import the file: {{message}}
importMapping: The column mapping is not valid.
importSkippedSentence_one: I skipped {{count}} line that was already there.
importSkippedSentence_other: I skipped {{count}} lines that were already there.
importAmbiguous: Day and month could be mixed up in the dates; I read them as {{format}}. Check a few lines.
importDeleteBody_one: The {{count}} line from this file is deleted.
importDeleteBody_other: The {{count}} lines from this file are deleted.
importDeleted: I deleted the file and its lines.
exportAbout_csv: One line per transaction: date, description, debit, credit, installment, kind, category. Opens in a spreadsheet and imports back into kalan.
exportAbout_plans: One line per running installment plan: installment amount, count left, last month and total left.
exportAbout_ofx: The format banking programs read. It holds one currency; lines in other currencies are left out.
exportAbout_hledger: A plain-text ledger. Installment plans are added as periodic transactions, shown by hledger --forecast.
exportAbout_beancount: A Beancount ledger. Installment plans are added as custom entries.
exportSkipped_one: {{count}} line in another currency is not in the OFX file.
exportSkipped_other: {{count}} lines in another currency are not in the OFX file.
diagnoseTitle: If your bank is not supported
diagnoseIntro: A diagnosis report holds only the statement's layout: every digit becomes 9, every letter a or A. No amount, name or merchant survives. Paste it into the form on GitHub and I will try to add your bank.
diagnoseHint: The file is not stored; only its layout is taken.
diagnoseNoText: This PDF is a scanned image with no text layer. Download the statement with text from your bank.
diagnoseTextHint: Read it once before sending. If a line still looks personal, delete it.
